responsibility: Defines the RTL operand and operation predicates specific to the MCore backend that are referenced throughout mcore.md pattern conditions and constraints. These predicates classify arithmetic registers, move sources and destinations, reload-time memory forms, immediate classes for arithmetic/shift/compare/call patterns, literal bit-test operands, and parallel load/store-multiple shapes, thereby controlling which RTL forms the MCore instruction patterns and splitters may accept before reload and during final matching.
